subject: Re: August invoice — mid-cycle ingest reallocation question
messages:
From: Elena Morris <finance@lumenai.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: accounts-payable@lumenai.com
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected mid-cycle reallocations on August invoice

Hi Ben,

We received the August invoice (attached) and noticed several mid-cycle reallocation line items that increased usage for our production workspace by ~18% compared to last week. The invoice shows multiple "reallocation" adjustments under the ingest bucket but there are no internal deployments that would explain the jump.

Can you explain what triggered these reassignments and provide the raw metering evidence (request IDs / timestamps) that map the charged tokens back to our tenant(s)? We need an explanation before we process payment — we've put the invoice on a short hold pending clarification.

Attaching the invoice PDF and a short spreadsheet we exported from our billing system.

Thanks,
Elena Morris
Finance Manager, LumenAI
Elena.Morris@lumenai.com
+1 (415) 555-0182

Attachment: LumenAI_August_Invoice_20260815.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <finance@lumenai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 18 Aug 2026 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle reallocations on August invoice

Hi Elena — thanks for flagging this and sorry for the surprise. I’ve looped in Lauren (billing ops) and Aditya (platform) so we can pull the log-level evidence.

A few quick asks that will speed our investigation: could you attach two or three example request IDs (or the request ID list) from your ingestion logs that correspond to the timestamps in the invoice? If you don’t have request IDs, a short list of approximate timestamps + source IPs will do.

What I’ll check on our side: whether we had any tenant tag backfills or topology changes (prefix remapping) during the billing window and whether the sampling window for your account was adjusted for a temporary backfill. If this looks like an attribution problem we typically issue a provisional credit while we finish the audit.

Plan: Lauren will run a focused meter export for 2026-08-01 -> 2026-08-15 and share a mapped CSV with per-prefix counts. Aditya will validate whether any internal routing/prefix reconciler job ran in that window.

Can you send the sample IDs by end-of-day?

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai | +1 (650) 555-0133

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <finance@lumenai.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 19 Aug 2026 14:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle reallocations on August invoice

Hi Elena and Ben — I pulled the per-prefix metering export for LumenAI (2026-08-01 through 2026-08-15) and ran a quick reconciliation against the billing window. Initial observations below.

Summary (initial):
- We have a small number (~0.7%) of tokens attributable to a previously-unmapped prefix (prefix P-99873) that was backfilled into your production workspace on 2026-08-12 due to a tenant-tagging sync job.
- The backfill was triggered by our prefix-reconciler process which corrected an earlier ingest-routing mismatch between staging and prod tenants. No customer action was required; the job mapped historical events to the correct tenant.
- Because those events were processed outside the original attribution window, they appear as mid-cycle reallocations on the invoice.

Evidence attached: a CSV (metering_viz_aug18.csv) with a per-minute delta and a small snapshot of the prefix mapping we used (prefix_counts_snapshot.json). The CSV includes the raw request_id column we can cross-reference.

Next steps I propose:
1) You provide two or three request_ids from the invoice lines you flagged (or attach the text file with the IDs).
2) We will produce a mapped export showing the exact timestamps and original attribution and then propose a pro-rated credit for the charged amount that corresponds to the backfilled tokens.

If you confirm the request_ids match the attached CSV, I will fast-track a credit memo and update the invoice.

Thanks,
Lauren Bishop
Billing Operations Lead, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.ai

Attachment: metering_viz_aug18.csv (text/csv)
Attachment: prefix_counts_snapshot.json (application/json)

From: Elena Morris <finance@lumenai.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 08:31:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle reallocations on August invoice

Thanks Lauren — attached are three request IDs pulled from the invoice lines we flagged plus a short mapping file from our side showing tenant_id -> internal_workspace mapping. All three IDs are included in the date range you specified and the timestamps match the rows in your CSV.

We appreciate the quick look. Please confirm the credit amount you will propose so I can route internally.

Elena

Attachment: lumenai-request-ids.txt (text/plain)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morris <finance@lumenai.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 21 Aug 2026 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected mid-cycle reallocations on August invoice

Hi Elena — thank you for the request IDs and the tenant mapping. Lauren validated the three IDs in our export and confirmed they were included in the backfill on 2026-08-12. Per our billing policies and the magnitude of the reattribution, we will issue a pro-rated credit of USD 2,345.67 and revise the August invoice to remove the backfilled tokens.

I’ve opened a DocuSign adjustment (link below) so we can sign off on the updated invoice; once signed we will reissue the corrected invoice and remove the hold on payment. The credit will also appear on your September statement if you prefer to keep the August invoice as-is and take the credit against next month — let me know which you’d prefer.

DocuSign (invoice adjustment): https://www.docusign.com/link/adjustment-RDW-6543
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/9876543210
Meter export (redacted): https://dashboard.redwood.ai/exports/usage/RDW-6543

Please reply with which option you prefer (reissue August invoice vs. credit on September statement) and I’ll get finance to process the chosen path immediately.

Appreciate the partnership — apologies again for the noise.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
